name: gate_colossus_gate_puts_it_on_top_of_your_library
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever a Gate you control enters, you may put this card from your graveyard on top of your library.' Gate Colossus is in seat 0's graveyard. On seat 1's turn seat 1 plays a Guildgate: not seat 0's, nothing is offered (an offer would raise: the step answers nothing). On seat 0's next turn (its draw took Lib C) seat 0 plays Azorius Guildgate and takes the offer ('fire'): the Colossus goes from the graveyard to the top of seat 0's library.
